name: SAP ECC to S/4HANA Migration Tool

mentions.name: SAP ECC to S/4HANA Migration Tool
mentions.description: Enterprise software for SAP migrations, comprising a Windows extraction tool plus a web app that automatically cleans and transforms master data, reducing migration work from months of manual Excel effort by consultants to days.
mentions.problem: Thousands of companies need to move from SAP ECC to S/4HANA before 2027, and master data quality is the #1 blocker.
mentions.audience: Companies migrating from SAP ECC to S/4HANA before 2027
mentions.source_excerpt: Enterprise software for SAP migrations. Thousands of companies need to move from ECC to S/4HANA before 2027, and master data quality is the #1 blocker. Built a Windows extraction tool + web app that cleans and transforms data automatically. What used to take consultants months of manual Excel work now happens in days.
